title: Predicting “priority” from “subject,body”
licence: Multilingual Customer Support Tickets. Licence: CC-BY-NC-4.0 (the creator’s current Hugging Face release). Commercial use: no. Non-commercial: experiments only. Don’t assume the current version permits training a model for a product that’s sold. The tickets are synthetic, and the versions share thousands of tickets, so never pool them.
setup: 28,586 texts, 3 labels, 5-fold stratified cross-validation. Character n-grams work across languages without a tokenizer.
decision: Best: words (tf-idf) + logistic regression, balanced accuracy 60% against 33% for always guessing the most common label. The data’s licence doesn’t allow commercial use, so no model is saved: this measures what’s possible, nothing more.
notes: 28,587 rows in the file; removed 1 repeating a text already in the file (case and spacing ignored); 28,586 measured.
By language (words (tf-idf) + logistic regression): de 53% of 12,249, en 65% of 16,337.
8,308 of these tickets (29%) also appear in dataset-tickets-multi-lang-4-20k.csv: the files are versions of one dataset, so each is measured on its own, never pooled.
